home.title: Cooplink — a marketplace for GitHub source code
home.hero_heading: A marketplace for source code you actually ship.
home.hero_desc: Connect a GitHub repo, set a price, get paid. Cooplink handles delivery, licensing, and payouts — you keep control of the code.
home.feature.github_body: Sign in with GitHub. List a repo you already own. No file uploads, no zip archives.
home.feature.access_body: Buyers get repo access the moment payment clears. Revoke on refund, no manual steps.
home.feature.payouts_body: Stripe Connect under the hood. Payouts land in under 48 hours in supported regions.
home.feature.protections_body: Disputes handled by humans. Reports, moderation, and an audit trail on every action.
home.step.connect_body: Authorize Cooplink for a single GitHub repository you own. Nothing else is touched.
home.step.price_body: Set a price, describe what it does, tag the stack. Submit for a fast review.
home.step.get_paid_body: When a developer buys, they get access and you get a payout. That's it.
home.what_you_get_heading: A marketplace with the parts that matter.
home.cta_desc: Free to list. 10% platform fee on sales. No monthly cost, no lock-in.
home.testimonial.1.text: The GitHub-native marketplace I've been waiting for.
home.testimonial.1.author: @auren
home.testimonial.2.text: Listed my first repo and got paid within 48 hours. Unreal.
home.testimonial.2.author: @mira
home.testimonial.3.text: Finally, a place to sell code without the zip-file song and dance.
home.testimonial.3.author: @sol
home.testimonial.4.text: Bought a boilerplate and had it running in 10 minutes.
home.testimonial.4.author: @rin
home.testimonial.5.text: The moderation gives me confidence as a buyer.
home.testimonial.5.author: @juno

about.title: About — Cooplink
about.meta_desc: Cooplink is a developer-run marketplace for source code.
about.heading: Built by developers.
about.para1: Cooplink exists because there was no clean way to buy or sell a working codebase. We believe developers should be able to monetize the projects they've already built — and buyers should be able to find production-grade source code without digging through abandoned repos.
about.para2: We take a 10% cut on sales. We don't sell ads. We don't sell your data. We don't lock you in. If this marketplace isn't useful to you someday, your listings come down and you move on.
